notes: Removed visible preview, build, SQL, sync, Supabase and development copy from the main app UI.
Dashboard no longer exposes role preview or technical maintenance panels.
Login copy now describes member access without database/internal approval wording.
Navigation groups use user-facing labels and no longer list technical maintenance links.
User management and notification screens use neutral user-facing copy.
Equipment loader/status text now uses catalog/evidencija wording instead of database/debug terms.
Restored the missing meeting-minutes to trip-announcement review flow.
Gmail-imported and manually uploaded DOCX minutes can be reviewed, deduplicated and approved into sov_trips.
Manual Gmail sync button writes a real Supabase queue request and no longer depends on a missing endpoint.
Gmail-imported meeting minutes automatically produce staging announcement cards when the page opens.
Announcement titles now prefer locations and expired announcements are excluded.
No SQL changes are required because the v6.1.40b/v6.1.41 backend is already present.
